turns.query: Compute the Voronoi (Thiessen) tessellation of all 18 air-quality monitoring stations and clip each cell to the axis-aligned bounding box of all station coordinates. Use geodesic area (cast to geography) in km². Return the TOTAL area (km², 1 dp) of the Voronoi cells belonging to the three roadside stations (station_id 14, 16, 17).
code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Explicit station_id resolution from the task; use as-is.
station_id_roadside_mong_kok = 14
station_id_roadside_central = 16
station_id_roadside_causeway_bay = 17
roadside_station_ids_explicit = [station_id_roadside_mong_kok, station_id_roadside_central, station_id_roadside_causeway_bay]
print(f"RESOLVED: roadside station_id 14 = {station_id_roadside_mong_kok}")
print(f"RESOLVED: roadside station_id 16 = {station_id_roadside_central}")
print(f"RESOLVED: roadside station_id 17 = {station_id_roadside_causeway_bay}")

# Domain interpretation notes for downstream spatial analysis.
aq_station_metadata_notes = {
    "station_type_values": ["GENERAL", "ROADSIDE"],
    "coordinate_crs": "WGS84 longitude/latitude (EPSG:4326)",
    "roadside_station_ids_expected": roadside_station_ids_explicit,
    "task_relevance": "Use station metadata and coordinates for Voronoi construction; roadside cells are identified by station_id 14, 16, and 17."
}

# Retrieve coordinates and metadata for all air-quality monitoring stations.
aq_station_metadata_df = pd.read_sql(text("""
    SELECT
        id AS station_id,
        name_en,
        address_en,
        ST_X(coordinate::geometry) AS longitude,
        ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) AS latitude,
        altitude,
        station_type::text AS station_type,
        area_type::text AS area_type,
        created_at
    FROM air_quality_station
    ORDER BY id
"""), engine)

print(f"aq_station_metadata_df row_count = {len(aq_station_metadata_df)}")
print(f"station_id_count = {aq_station_metadata_df['station_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"station_type_counts = {aq_station_metadata_df['station_type'].value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict()}")
print(f"coordinate_missing_counts = {aq_station_metadata_df[['longitude','latitude']].isna().sum().to_dict()}")
print(f"station_id_min_max = ({int(aq_station_metadata_df['station_id'].min()) if len(aq_station_metadata_df) else None}, {int(aq_station_metadata_df['station_id'].max()) if len(aq_station_metadata_df) else None})")

# Verify the explicit roadside station ids have metadata and are marked ROADSIDE.
roadside_station_metadata_df = aq_station_metadata_df[aq_station_metadata_df["station_id"].isin(roadside_station_ids_explicit)].copy()
print(f"roadside_station_metadata_df row_count = {len(roadside_station_metadata_df)}")
print(f"roadside_station_type_check = {roadside_station_metadata_df.set_index('station_id')['station_type'].to_dict() if len(roadside_station_metadata_df) else {}}")
print(f"roadside_station_name_check = {roadside_station_metadata_df.set_index('station_id')['name_en'].to_dict() if len(roadside_station_metadata_df) else {}}")
print(f"roadside_coordinate_missing_counts = {roadside_station_metadata_df[['longitude','latitude']].isna().sum().to_dict() if len(roadside_station_metadata_df) else {}}")

# Re-check ids if expected roadside metadata are absent or not ROADSIDE.
missing_roadside_ids = sorted(set(roadside_station_ids_explicit) - set(roadside_station_metadata_df["station_id"].tolist()))
non_roadside_explicit_ids = sorted(roadside_station_metadata_df.loc[roadside_station_metadata_df["station_type"] != "ROADSIDE", "station_id"].tolist())
if missing_roadside_ids or non_roadside_explicit_ids:
    aq_station_roadside_recheck_df = pd.read_sql(text("""
        SELECT
            id AS station_id,
            name_en,
            ST_X(coordinate::geometry) AS longitude,
            ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) AS latitude,
            station_type::text AS station_type
        FROM air_quality_station
        WHERE id = ANY(:ids)
        ORDER BY id
    """), engine, params={"ids": roadside_station_ids_explicit})
    print(f"aq_station_roadside_recheck_df row_count = {len(aq_station_roadside_recheck_df)}")
    print(f"roadside_recheck_type_counts = {aq_station_roadside_recheck_df['station_type'].value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict() if len(aq_station_roadside_recheck_df) else {}}")
    if missing_roadside_ids:
        print(f"UNRESOLVED: explicit roadside station ids missing from metadata {missing_roadside_ids}")
    if non_roadside_explicit_ids:
        print(f"UNRESOLVED: explicit roadside station ids not marked ROADSIDE {non_roadside_explicit_ids}")
else:
    print("roadside_station_id_validation = OK")

# Compact spatial extent summary for downstream checks; do not compute Voronoi or final output here.
aq_station_coordinate_extent = {
    "min_longitude": float(aq_station_metadata_df["longitude"].min()) if len(aq_station_metadata_df) else None,
    "max_longitude": float(aq_station_metadata_df["longitude"].max()) if len(aq_station_metadata_df) else None,
    "min_latitude": float(aq_station_metadata_df["latitude"].min()) if len(aq_station_metadata_df) else None,
    "max_latitude": float(aq_station_metadata_df["latitude"].max()) if len(aq_station_metadata_df) else None,
}
print(f"aq_station_coordinate_extent = {aq_station_coordinate_extent}")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pyproj import Geod
from shapely.geometry import Point, MultiPoint, box, Polygon
from shapely.ops import voronoi_diagram

# Reuse staged station metadata and explicit roadside ids
voronoi_source_station_df = aq_station_metadata_df.copy()
voronoi_target_station_ids = [station_id_roadside_mong_kok, station_id_roadside_central, station_id_roadside_causeway_bay]

# Identify coordinate/id columns from staged metadata without re-querying
cols_lower = {c.lower(): c for c in voronoi_source_station_df.columns}
id_col = next((cols_lower[c] for c in ["station_id", "id"] if c in cols_lower), None)
lon_col = next((cols_lower[c] for c in ["longitude", "lon", "lng", "x"] if c in cols_lower), None)
lat_col = next((cols_lower[c] for c in ["latitude", "lat", "y"] if c in cols_lower), None)

if id_col is None or lon_col is None or lat_col is None:
    raise ValueError(f"Staged station metadata lacks identifiable id/lon/lat columns. Columns available: {list(voronoi_source_station_df.columns)}")

voronoi_input_points_df = (
    voronoi_source_station_df[[id_col, lon_col, lat_col]]
    .dropna()
    .rename(columns={id_col: "station_id", lon_col: "lon", lat_col: "lat"})
)
voronoi_input_points_df["station_id"] = voronoi_input_points_df["station_id"].astype(int)

if len(voronoi_input_points_df) != 18:
    raise ValueError(f"Expected 18 station coordinates, found {len(voronoi_input_points_df)} after dropping null coordinates.")
missing_targets_for_voronoi = sorted(set(voronoi_target_station_ids) - set(voronoi_input_points_df["station_id"]))
if missing_targets_for_voronoi:
    raise ValueError(f"Target roadside station ids missing from staged coordinates: {missing_targets_for_voronoi}")

# Compute planar lon/lat Voronoi/Thiessen polygons and clip to the axis-aligned bbox of all station coordinates
min_lon, max_lon = voronoi_input_points_df["lon"].min(), voronoi_input_points_df["lon"].max()
min_lat, max_lat = voronoi_input_points_df["lat"].min(), voronoi_input_points_df["lat"].max()
station_coordinate_bbox_polygon = box(min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat)

station_points_by_id = {
    int(r.station_id): Point(float(r.lon), float(r.lat))
    for r in voronoi_input_points_df.itertuples(index=False)
}
all_station_multipoint = MultiPoint(list(station_points_by_id.values()))
raw_voronoi_geometry_collection = voronoi_diagram(all_station_multipoint, envelope=station_coordinate_bbox_polygon, edges=False)

geod = Geod(ellps="WGS84")
voronoi_clipped_cell_area_km2_by_station_id = {}

for sid, pt in station_points_by_id.items():
    containing_polys = [geom for geom in raw_voronoi_geometry_collection.geoms if geom.covers(pt)]
    if not containing_polys:
        raise ValueError(f"No Voronoi polygon found for station_id {sid}.")
    clipped = containing_polys[0].intersection(station_coordinate_bbox_polygon)
    if clipped.is_empty:
        area_m2 = 0.0
    elif clipped.geom_type == "Polygon":
        area_m2 = abs(geod.geometry_area_perimeter(clipped)[0])
    else:
        area_m2 = sum(abs(geod.geometry_area_perimeter(g)[0]) for g in clipped.geoms if g.geom_type == "Polygon")
    voronoi_clipped_cell_area_km2_by_station_id[sid] = area_m2 / 1_000_000.0

target_roadside_voronoi_cell_areas_km2 = {
    sid: voronoi_clipped_cell_area_km2_by_station_id[sid]
    for sid in voronoi_target_station_ids
}
roadside_voronoi_cells_sum_km2_unrounded = float(sum(target_roadside_voronoi_cell_areas_km2.values()))
roadside_voronoi_cells_sum_km2_rounded_1dp = round(roadside_voronoi_cells_sum_km2_unrounded, 1)

print({
    "station_count_used": len(voronoi_input_points_df),
    "target_station_ids": voronoi_target_station_ids,
    "target_cell_area_km2_rounded_3dp": {sid: round(area, 3) for sid, area in target_roadside_voronoi_cell_areas_km2.items()},
    "target_sum_km2_rounded_1dp": roadside_voronoi_cells_sum_km2_rounded_1dp
})

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

old_roadside_cells_km2 = roadside_cells_km2

query = text("""
WITH stations AS (
    SELECT id, coordinate::geometry AS geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
bbox AS (
    SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(
        MIN(ST_X(geom)), MIN(ST_Y(geom)),
        MAX(ST_X(geom)), MAX(ST_Y(geom)),
        4326
    ) AS geom
    FROM stations
),
vor AS (
    SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(geom), 0.0))).geom AS cell_geom
    FROM stations
),
assigned AS (
    SELECT s.id AS station_id,
           ST_Intersection(v.cell_geom, b.geom) AS clipped_geom
    FROM vor v
    CROSS JOIN bbox b
    JOIN stations s
      ON ST_Covers(v.cell_geom, s.geom)
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stations) AS station_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assigned) AS assigned_cell_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assigned WHERE station_id IN (14,16,17)) AS target_cell_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN station_id IN (14,16,17)
                 THEN ST_Area(clipped_geom::geography) / 1000000.0
                 ELSE 0 END) AS target_area_km2
    FROM assigned
)
SELECT station_count, assigned_cell_count, target_cell_count, target_area_km2
FROM summary;
""")

res = pd.read_sql(query, engine).iloc[0]
independent_unrounded = float(res["target_area_km2"])
independent_rounded = round(independent_unrounded, 1)
roadside_cells_km2 = independent_rounded

print(f"Station count used: {int(res['station_count'])}")
print(f"Voronoi cells assigned: {int(res['assigned_cell_count'])}")
print(f"Target roadside cells assigned: {int(res['target_cell_count'])}")
print(f"VERIFY roadside_cells_km2: stored={old_roadside_cells_km2} | independent={independent_rounded} | final={roadside_cells_km2}")
print(f"roadside_cells_km2={roadside_cells_km2}")
